nom: I Dew Care Cake My Day Hydrating Sprinkle Wash-Off Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily T-zone skin, including a teen with acne-prone oily skin, report the mask hydrates without adding shine, keeps pores looking smaller, and does not trigger breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are the most represented group and overwhelmingly positive, several describing the mask as rescuing flaking, cold-weather-damaged, or postpartum-dehydrated skin within days; a minority dissent, with two reporting no noticeable hydration difference and their driest patches staying dry.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including oily T-zones paired with drier patches around the nose, mouth, or cheeks, consistently report the mask leaves their skin balanced, hydrated, and neither greasy nor stripped.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with eczema or rosacea, report the mask as gentle, non-irritating, and hydrating without stripping; dissent is real, though: one says a reformulation now irritates rather than soothes her eczema-prone skin, one reports a mild burning sensation that faded during use, and one reports her teenage daughter suffered a bad skin reaction after two uses.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who mentions her age, 45, says this is one of the few masks that does not dry out her face and finds it very hydrating.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with severely dry or cold-weather-damaged skin, report the mask leaves skin noticeably softer, smoother, and hydrated, sometimes within days; a minority dissent, saying they saw no real hydration difference or that their driest patches stayed dry despite the softening effect elsewhere.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the mask calms redness, including improvement in rosacea-prone cheeks and chin; others, however, describe new redness or a brief burning sensation after applying it, in one case linked to the product's scent.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers managing eczema mostly report the mask keeps their skin calm and hydrated without triggering flare-ups; against that, one reviewer says a recent reformulation now irritates her eczema-prone skin instead of soothing it, and one reports her daughter suffered a bad skin reaction after two uses.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report a more even skin tone and smoother texture within one to two uses, though this is a secondary benefit few reviewers focus on directly.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts, including several who say they usually break out from new products, report this mask does not cause new blemishes and may even help pores look smaller; dissent comes from two reviewers who broke out or got a pimple after use, one linking it to the scent.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with an oily T-zone report the mask hydrates without leaving oil, shine, or blots, describing it as light rather than heavy or greasy.

aspects.libelle: Thick texture, can be hard to rinse off
Fun, cute packaging with spatula and sprinkles
Does not remove makeup, apply to a clean face
Stays soft on skin rather than tightening or drying down
Small amount goes a long way
Pricier than buying a multi-product bundle

extraits.titre: If I could give this a NO star review, I would!
extraits.texte: My 14 yr old used this twice in 3 days and had a chemical reaction to her skin. She was burnt very badly from the mix of ingredients in this product!

They must have reformulated within the time that I last bought this, because what used to be a sweet, cake scented oasis from my eczema now not only doesn't smell anything like it used to, but also now irritates my skin, rather than soothing it

extraits.titre: Cute Gimmick, Doesn't Work As Well As I Hoped
extraits.texte: I was so excited to try this mask, and although I wasn't ripped off, it doesn't moisturize my skin at all. The smell and look is great, and it definitely softened my skin and helped the texture a bit. The areas in which I'm very dry are still dry. However, I must just be unlucky because many other reviewers say it helped moisturize, haha! You get bang for your buck at least, I only needed less than a tablespoon's worth for one use. Great idea and I'll definitely use it again for fun, but I will have to continue my search on finding something that helps the dry issue with my skin.

I have combo skin: oily on the t-zone, smooth on the cheeks. I received a sampler of this face mask in one of Ulta's Diamond Member Variety Samplers with a purchase. I thought, 'Okay, this smells nice and it will be fun to use up then toss the container.' From beginning to end, I love the product. The scent is exactly like warm, vanilla cake. It's a fresh-baked cake scent, not sugary or powdery smelling like frosting. The mask applies well, dries down nicely and washes away easily. It leaves my skin with a clean feel but doesn't dry it out or leave me with oil blots. It's gentle enough to use 3-4 times a week and works well enough with my combo skin that I, being someone who is a little more particular about my products (usually a Thomas Roth gal), have purchased two new full-sized products. I am prone to breakouts when trying new products. I didn't have enough in the sample size to use this more than three times, but I had enough to know my skin stayed balanced each time I did. I'll be bummed if they discontinue this product and happy if they "Cake My Day" by keeping it :)

I absolutely love the smell of the mask. It's so cute with the little sprinkles. I have really sensitive skin and rosacea, it's hard to find anything that doesn't irritate my skin. This was super refreshing when I applied it and left my skin amazingly soft and smooth after I removed it. I actually love that it doesn't dry down because I hate feeling so stiff with most masks. This is definitely my new go to mask and I can't wait to try more!

(Teen review) This product is great, I expected it to be very gimmicky and not do anything, but I was pleasantly surprised. I apply it all over my face two - three times a week and I genuinely have seen a difference. My nose has had super dry patches that even with moisturizer left my nose and upper lip looking like the aftermath of a sunburn. It also has seemed to improve the rosacea in my cheeks and chin. My eczema has not been negatively effected by this at all, even with the amazing smell. I'm not a huge fan of face masks in general but I absolutely love this. Also im in my mid teens and might get a pimple every two months so I can't attest to any acne solving properties of this but it hasn't increased or decreased pimples or bumps. Additionally I have been using this for about 8 weeks now and have seen a real improvement since the third or fourth time I used it.

Bought this outta of the blue! Cute packaging draws me in. I have dry and sensitive skin. A little hesitant to get it cause ever face mask I get always seems to burn me. Applying it went on smooth and smells delicious like CAKE! I had a bit of burning feeling but also cooling and heat. It felt ok I just fan it and it went away. Not an everyday use tho. Fun for once in a while. After using it I did notice my face being very smooth and hydrated! will buy as a gift for a family & friend. I'll also buy a mini one instead of full size next time.
